name: quarter
description: Calendar quarter of the report, 1 to 4

name: report_date
description: Last calendar day of the reporting quarter

name: rssd_id
description: RSSD identifier assigned by the Federal Reserve, unique per institution and stable across name and charter changes; the join key across every table in this dataset. To reach us_fdic_bankfind, join through institution.fdic_cert_id, which carries the FDIC certificate

name: name
description: Legal name of the holding company

name: short_name
description: Abbreviated name of the holding company

name: address
description: Street address of the holding company's physical location

name: city
description: City of the holding company's physical location

name: state_abbreviation
description: Two-letter postal abbreviation of the state of the physical location
observations: Not linked to the state directory: its primary key is the FIPS code.

name: zip_code
description: ZIP code of the holding company's physical location

name: county_id
description: Five-digit FIPS code of the county of the physical location
observations: Built from the state FIPS code (RSSD9210) and the county code (RSSD9150), both of which the filer reports separately.

name: tax_id
description: Employer identification number of the entity

name: charter_type_id
description: Charter type code assigned by the Federal Reserve
observations: The code list is published by the National Information Center rather than with the data, so the values are carried as filed and are not decoded here.

name: organization_type_id
description: Organization type code assigned by the Federal Reserve
observations: The code list is published by the National Information Center rather than with the data, so the values are carried as filed and are not decoded here.

name: primary_activity_id
description: NAICS code of the entity's primary activity, 551111 for a bank holding company
observations: Not linked to the NAICS directory: the series spans four decades and several NAICS vintages, which the source does not restate.

name: federal_reserve_district_id
description: Federal Reserve district that supervises the entity, 1 to 12

name: bank_count
description: Number of banks the holding company controls

name: is_financial_holding_company
description: Whether the entity has elected financial holding company status, 1 for yes

name: is_savings_loan_holding_company
description: Whether the entity is a savings and loan holding company, 1 for yes
